summary: Preserve uncertain iOS sidebar writes when replay admission fails

replay.detail: The reducer marks each send First or Replay. Replay errors, including applied=none, retain the original identity and compound edit progress as unknown delivery; only explicit replay or readback resolves uncertainty.

schema.detail: Journal v1 is unchanged. Delivery provenance is transient and defaults to Replay after restore.

compatibility.detail: Existing durable sidebar records remain readable; first-delivery refusals are unchanged and the journal close storage barrier is preserved.

recovery.detail: Unresolved edits retain their persisted request identity for explicit replay or authoritative readback.
